scope: Synthetic bottom-up and top-down pool cases plus one Windows 10 19041 x64 crash dump. Not a 32-bit, pre-Windows 8, or timeline acceptance.

comparison.scope: selected fields only; full capability acceptance remains pending

notes: Compared fields are the low 48 bits of Offset, StartAddress and Win32StartAddress, PID, TID, both start paths, and second-truncated create and exit times.
The go test binary that produced the compared JSONL is 72dad763a0c836dae3cb70fb09f1a37ef9f56fe298894d13d3cd4c4ef974f8be.
The active windows.threads reference has the same 1752 low-48 offsets. This image has no pool thread outside PsActiveProcessHead's thread lists.
Four create times are absent. Exit times include the pinned signed FILETIME values whose year is 1600.
The year window uses the local year at runtime. This comparison ran in 2026.
